name: Flirtatious Fibber
body:
You easily deceive those who are attracted to you.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, Bluff 3 ranks

Benefit: When you use Bluff to fool a target who is physically or romantically attracted to you, you get a +4 bonus to your check, and you reduce the penalties associated with the believability of the lie by 50% (e.g., from -5 to -2 or from -20 to -10).
